source: docs/helsinki-d1/published-network.json (HSL Metro haarukka 10/2023 + Tervetuloa metroon 2/2025). Not generated from GTFS.
notes: v1: metro M1 and M2 only. No tram, no bus, no HSL/VR commuter rail, no Suomenlinna ferry, no Itämetro.
Direction model: line + terminus (M1 + Kivenlahti). Rautatientori is a through-trunk hub, not a compass CBD — never inbound/outbound vs City.
Current west branches Kivenlahti (M1) and Tapiola (M2). Matinkylä is a stop, not a terminus chip (former west end 2017-2 Dec 2022).
Current east branches Vuosaari (M1) and Mellunmäki (M2).
